neon.contrast: 5.3:1 on panel (large text and borders only)

display.purpose: Page titles: site name, Usage, Accounts. 2rem at 640px and below; auth titles 1.875rem.

numeral.purpose: Headline stat values in sodium; red neon with glow when alerting.

headline.purpose: Section headings in the content column.

brand.purpose: The CONCIERGE wordmark in teal with glow; 1.35rem in the phone strip.

sign.purpose: Navigation signs; 1rem on phones, 0.95rem for quiet signs.

title.purpose: Panel and card header strips in teal; speaker labels at 0.875rem.

body.purpose: All running text; prose capped at 72ch.

label.purpose: Stat labels, notes, field hints, segmented control.

column-head.purpose: Uppercase table headers and stacked-row cell labels in subtle ink.

mono.purpose: URLs, hosts, paths, snippets, keys only.

shadows.name: glow-neon
shadows.purpose: Text glow on the current sign and alert numerals; critical lamp and full meter.

shadows.name: glow-teal
shadows.purpose: Brand mark, live lamp, meter fill.

shadows.name: sign-current
shadows.purpose: Tube light inside and around the lit sign box.

shadows.name: sign-hover-text
shadows.purpose: Half-lit text glow on a hovered or focused sign.

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused text field, select or textarea.

shadows.name: primary-hover
shadows.purpose: Sodium spill under a hovered primary button.

shadows.name: lamp-crit
shadows.purpose: Critical status lamp with halo ring.

shadows.name: chart-day-hover
shadows.purpose: Filter glow on the hovered day bar.

shadows.name: auth-bloom
shadows.purpose: The single signed-out panel; the only ambient shadow in the world.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global focus-visible ring on links, buttons and signs.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Expo-out easing for every state transition.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Buttons, inputs, links, segments, rows, chart hover.

motion.name: duration-sign
motion.purpose: Sign colour, border and glow transitions.

motion.name: sign-flicker
motion.purpose: Tube-flicker when a sign is hovered or focused; never on the current sign.

motion.name: lamp-pulse
motion.value: 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; opacity 0.35 and no glow at 50%

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to everything in the world under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

breakpoints.name: rail-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Rail becomes a sticky top bar with a horizontally scrolling sign strip; notice bars and content padding tighten.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: List tables become stacked rows; page title drops to 2rem.

breakpoints.name: small-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Chart hides minor and zero ticks and enlarges tick text.

narrative.overview:
The admin app, the owner console and the auth screens are a street of signboards at night. Navigation is a vertical stack of unlit sign boxes and the section you are in is the one switched on in red neon. Everything else is wet near-black ground, 1px-ruled sheet-metal panels and quiet grey ink, so the few lit things read instantly: the brand sign, the current section, a live lamp, a number, a problem. It deliberately refuses the category default of a white SaaS shell with a blue accent and soft cards.

The world serves an Operate mode for non-technical shop owners who check in for two minutes a few times a week. Density is moderate: panels stack in a single content column of up to 82rem with a 15rem rail, numbers are large and sodium-yellow so they can be read at a glance, and every panel carries the same teal header strip so the page reads as one system. Light is information, not decoration: glow appears only on something that is current, live or wrong, and the interface stays dark and still otherwise. The world is dark only, by decision; it never ships a light theme. The embeddable visitor widget is outside this world and keeps its own per-merchant theme.
keyCharacteristics: Three surface values (ground, panel, well) separated by exactly-1px rules, never by shadows.
Three tube colours with one job each: teal for links, panel heads, focus and data; sodium for numbers and the primary action; red neon for the lit sign and real critical state.

Saira Condensed uppercase for anything that is a sign (headings, nav, panel heads, headline numbers, speaker labels); Geist for every sentence, label and control; Geist Mono only for URLs, hosts, snippets and keys.
A signature tube-flicker on sign hover and focus; under reduced motion every animation is off.
Measured WCAG AA everywhere: body ink 17.1:1, the quietest text 6.1:1, control boundaries 3.1:1 on panels.

rules.name: The One Lit Sign Rule
rules.body: Red neon marks the section you are in and real critical state. Nothing decorative is ever red, and row-level destructive buttons stay unlit until reached so no row out-shouts the current sign.

rules.name: The One Job Per Tube Rule
rules.body: Teal is for links, panel heads, focus and data; sodium is for numbers and the primary action; neon is for the lit sign and critical state. A colour never borrows another tube's job.

rules.name: The Glow Means Live Rule
rules.body: Glow (text-shadow or box-shadow bloom) appears only on something lit: the brand mark, the current sign, a live or alert lamp, an alert numeral, a filled meter, a focused input, a hovered chart day. Static content never glows.

rules.name: The Signboard Face Rule
rules.body: Saira Condensed is only for things that are signs: headings, nav, panel heads, headline numbers, speaker labels. Sentences, labels, form fields and buttons are always Geist.

rules.name: The Controls Speak Plain Rule
rules.body: A button, link, select or badge placed inside a header strip or speaker label drops back to Geist, sentence case, normal tracking.

rules.name: The Machine Text Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only on text a machine produced or will consume: URLs, hosts, paths, the embed snippet, keys.

rules.name: The Transcript Owns Its Column Rule
rules.body: A conversation transcript takes the main column alone; metadata (email, pages visited) sits in a side column on desktop and below it on phones, never interleaved with messages.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every rule and border is exactly 1px, and there are only three surface values (ground, panel, well). Separation is drawn, never shaded.

rules.name: The Light, Not Lift Rule
rules.body: In-app panels, cards and notices carry no drop shadow; something becomes prominent by being lit.

rules.name: The Sheet-Metal Corner Rule
rules.body: 4px for anything you operate, 6px for anything that contains, round only for lamps and meters. No pills, no large radii.

dos: **Do** keep every border and divider at exactly 1px and build depth from the three surfaces: ground, panel, well.
**Do** light exactly one nav sign per page in red neon, the section the owner is in.
**Do** set every headline number in sodium Saira Condensed with a label and a note saying what it counts and over what period.
**Do** open every panel with the teal Saira Condensed header strip, and keep controls inside it in plain Geist.
**Do** give each form or work area at most one sodium primary button, for the action it exists for; everything else is the outlined secondary button.
**Do** use the authored 16px icon set (1.6 stroke, currentColor, round caps), decorative unless labelled.
**Do** keep text at or above the measured contrasts: Ink 17.1:1, Muted 8.2:1, Subtle 6.1:1 on panels, and control boundaries at 3.1:1.
**Do** turn every animation off and make transitions instant under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: **Don't** ship a light theme or light panels; this world is dark only by decision.
**Don't** use red neon for decoration, emphasis or ordinary destructive rows at rest; it is the lit sign and real critical state only.
**Don't** put glow on static content; glow is reserved for things that are current, live or alerting.
**Don't** add drop shadows to in-app panels, cards or notices; the auth panel's neon bloom is the single exception.
**Don't** set sentences, labels, form fields or buttons in Saira Condensed, and don't use Geist Mono for anything but URLs, hosts, snippets and keys.
**Don't** set small body text in red neon (5.3:1); use Danger Pink for critical copy.
**Don't** round controls past 4px or containers past 6px, and don't use pill buttons.
**Don't** apply this world to the embeddable visitor widget; it keeps its own per-merchant theme.
